join_contract.primary: bodyId joins only the male-cns:v1.0 graph body/body_pre/body_post identifiers; never FlyWire root IDs.
join_contract.curated_homology: mancGroup -> Cheong group; many-to-many identity correspondence, never neural signal copying.
join_contract.type_crosswalk: Current official type/mancType plus subclass, accepting only unambiguous named targets.
join_contract.untrusted: mancBodyid is predicted and never used to assign a muscle or side; preserve its source record and conflicts.
join_contract.laterality: side is official somaSide only. peripheral_target_sides is the canonical list of supported L/R outputs. Scalar peripheral_target_side is set only for unilateral innervation; bilateral scalar null is not missing evidence. unpaired_organ_group has no fabricated L/R split. Never share opposite neurons drive.
join_contract.semantic: semantic_muscle_key names an anatomical muscle/group at stated resolution; it is not an actuator ID or motor-unit force weight.

constraints: No artificial synaptic or NMJ edges created.

Missing targets and sides stay null; body-region targets do not count as muscles.

Asynchronous flight-power physiology must not be replaced with a scripted wingbeat.
All runtime connections are false because this artifact creates no active simulation binding.
